description: Harness governance — deny before allow, fail-closed (học OpenBot CEL policy + BTP pre-flight KN-012)

deny.message: Refuse direct read of credentials.enc.json — use credentials.mjs
Refuse private host access via shell — use allowlist

deny.when: (tool === 'edit' || tool === 'write' || tool === 'shell') && (target.includes('Tests') || target.toLowerCase().includes('.test.') || target.toLowerCase().includes('.spec.') || target.includes('ai-news.json')) && actor.toLowerCase() !== 'verify' && intent !== 'takeover'
deny.message: Refuse mutating test/verifier files — tests are immutable, fix production code instead (KN-012). Human takeover via intent=takeover.

deny.when: tool === 'shell' && (target.toLowerCase().includes('drop table') || target.toLowerCase().includes('drop schema') || target.toLowerCase().includes('truncate table'))
deny.message: Refuse destructive SQL (DROP/TRUNCATE) via shell — use migration review (KN-012)
